newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bank to seek listing on Lisbon bourse.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bank to seek listing on Lisbon bourse.

text.p: Portuguese bank Central Banco de Investimentos (CBI) will apply to be listed on Lisbon bourse later this year, the bank's vice-president Jose Lemos told reporters.
"The listing of the CBI on Lisbon bourse will be this year," Lemos said. He did not give a date.
The bank also plans to raise its capital by one billion escudos to seven billion via incorporation from reserves, Lemos said.

The main shareholders of CBI are: Caixa Central with a 25 percent stake, IP (Ilidio Pinho) holding and businessman Ilidio Pinho with 15 percent, Grupo Valouro and the pension fund of Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor with 10 percent each, and Grupo Papelaco with about nine percent.
